CALENDAR BOOKING

Frequently Asked Questions

See All FAQs
How does Popl's calendar booking work at trade shows and events?

Popl’s Universal Badge Scanner mobile app enables you to scan anything, whether an event badge, paper business card, or LinkedIn QR code. After capturing a lead, just tap the calendar icon on their profile to open your scheduling link. 

Popl automatically pre-fills your lead's contact details into the booking form. For Calendly, HubSpot Meetings, and Chili Piper, fields such as name, email, and company are populated automatically. A one-tap copy button lets you paste that info in seconds for other platforms.

Once the meeting is booked, Popl asks if you secured it. Say “yes,” and a checkmark appears on the lead's profile so your whole team can see at a glance who's been booked. Every lead's status is accounted for before you've even left the event.

Which calendar apps does Popl integrate with for booking meetings?

Popl works with any scheduling tool: Calendly, Google Calendar, HubSpot Meetings, Microsoft Bookings, Chili Piper, and more. Just paste in a valid calendar URL, and you're ready to go. If your scheduling platform has a bookable link, Popl supports it.

Each user can save up to 10 calendar links. Give each a name, so your reps stay organized when booking different types of meetings. Drag and drop to rearrange them. 

Setup takes seconds. Just add your links once, and every lead you capture at an event is one tap away from a booked meeting.

Can I book meetings directly from a badge scan at a conference?

Yes. Popl combines badge scanning and calendar booking in a single app, so you can capture a lead and schedule a meeting without ever switching tools.

After scanning a badge, the lead's contact details are saved to your Popl account instantly. From there, tap the calendar icon on their profile, choose your meeting link, and your scheduling tool opens with their information ready to go.

The result is a faster path from conversation to confirmed meeting. Your reps stay focused on selling while the context is still fresh, rather than chasing leads days later with follow-up emails. 

Popl works at any conference or trade show, with any badge format, using any scheduling tool your team already uses.

How do I track which leads booked meetings at my event?

Popl makes it easy to see meeting status at a glance. After opening a calendar booking link, Popl asks, "Did you book a meeting with this lead?" Select “Yes,” and a checkmark appears on the lead's profile. When you tap the calendar icon again on a lead with a booked meeting, you'll see a "Booked" tag next to the link used.

The result? Your team gets a clear record of every meeting booked on the floor.

Does Popl's meeting scheduler require any technical setup?

Not at all. Popl's Calendar Booking doesn’t require permissions or IT support to set up. Simply add a calendar link from any scheduling platform, give it a label, and save. That's it.

Individual reps can add their own links directly from the Popl mobile app, while admins can set up and manage calendar links for the entire team from the web dashboard. Either way, your team can be ready to book meetings before the event starts.
